search_text.md:
## About us
Avanti Fellows is an NGO which provides deserving underprivileged children access to quality education. A part of
their efforts is to provide guidance to XI and XII students in their preparation for competitive examinations like
JEE Mains and JEE Advanced. Avanti ties up with various residential JNVs (Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya) where the
students live and attend school and are mentored by students from an IIT/NIT nearby.

## FAQs
**Why should I join this? What's in it for me?**
One of the very few teams you can join in your freshie year. You learn responsibility, teamwork and communication,
make friends (many mentors made their closest insti friends here), get "fundaes" from seniors, and make a direct
positive impact on someone's life.

**What is Avanti Fellows?**
An NGO that gives deserving underprivileged children a chance to get into an IIT. Students are shortlisted through
an entrance exam and allotted to Avanti chapters. Each chapter is a Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV) that provides
accommodation and school; Avanti teachers give JEE lectures; students from a nearby IIT/NIT give one-to-one mentoring.

**How will the selection process take place?**
Starts a couple of days after classes begin. Tentative: classes begin 31 July; application form (Google Form) in the
1st week of August; interviews from the 2nd week of September (after Quiz 1). The interview looks at experience,
communication and interest, with some academic-aptitude questions; no special preparation needed. The number of
selections depends on the number of mentees; **39 mentors this year**.

**What will my role be?**
Clear your mentee's doubts regularly, help with test analysis, guide their preparation, and sometimes make a
schedule with them. Stay in contact throughout the tenure and **call them twice a week**.

**Where are the mentees from?**
From all over the country, studying at **JNV Pondicherry**, class 11. This year: Karnataka, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and
Telangana. All speak/understand English; native-language comfort is considered when mapping mentors.

**How many mentees will I be responsible for?** At most 1.

**How many hours per week?** About 3–4, flexible around classes.

**Can I manage academics and Avanti?** Yes, with free time left for other interests.

**Can I decide later?** No: once selection is done, no one else can be taken into the team.

**Duration?** A year-long commitment; the team's tenure ends when the next team takes over.

**How often will I travel to Pondicherry?**
Mentors are divided into sub-groups of 4–5; each week one mentor from each sub-group travels, so roughly **once a
month**. A senior (a Core Team member: Manager or Head) goes on every trip. **Bus fare is reimbursed by Avanti Fellows.**

## Achievements
- **2023:** 100% selection in JEE Mains; 9 students in top IITs; 4 in top IIITs; 14 in top NITs
- **2024:** 100% selection in JEE Mains; 9 in top IITs; 6 in top IIITs; 11 in top NITs; 3 in top IISERs
